title: Stellar Engineering
description: Ignite a captive star from white-hole ejecta.

puzzle.goal: A captive star of radius R radiates as a black body at surface temperature T. Write its total power output, divided by 4π²R², as the integral over all frequencies of the spectral radiance of thermal radiation (photon modes, each occupied according to Bose statistics).
puzzle.name: Stefan–Boltzmann law (integrated Planck spectrum)
puzzle.ask: The integral equals σT⁴/π, so L = 4πR²σT⁴. In solar units (R in solar radii, Ts = solar surface temperature), find the luminosity in solar luminosities.
puzzle.method: Integrate the radiance of every frequency; substitute x = hν/kBT to pull out T⁴.
